decision.reason: REJECTED on flow development. NUMERICALLY_UNHEALTHY: Although the streamwise force fx and vertical force fy appear to reach a steady mean, the lateral force fz exhibits an unbounded, escalating oscillation amplitude over time. This systematic growth in lateral force fluctuations indicates a numerical instability or unphysical feedback loop in the spanwise direction, requiring a safe stop.

STILL_DEVELOPING: Although streamwise and vertical force components (fx and fy) appear largely stable in the later time windows, the lateral force component (fz) exhibits growing fluctuation amplitude and standard deviation up to the final recorded window (t = 70 to 80). This indicates that the 3-D wake structures are still developing and have not reached a statistically stationary state across all components.
